steps.note: Inspect. The records in scope are listed, and any skipped file is reported.
Partition. The records are cut into chunks, each read on its own.
Map. Each chunk is checked against this skill's rules, one chunk at a time.
Rank. Each matter is placed by its owner, its last action and its status.
Verify. Each cited line is re-read, and a finding that does not hold is dropped.
Report. Status: draft for the owner to review. It is not a decision.

outcome.verdict: 1 matter has had no action for 14 days

findings.title: No action for 14 days
findings.fix: Set the next action and its date

findings.title: Status unchanged for three weeks
findings.fix: Confirm the status with the owner

example:
Illustrative example: the items and results are made up, not real output.

[medium] matter-0706.md:19  Status unchanged for three weeks.

pros: Checks a matter with no owner, a matter with no action for 14 days, and a status that did not change for three weeks.
cons: Not checked: The merits of each matter.
input: The records for this review, as text or CSV
output: A draft report: findings with location, fix and a not-checked list
prompt: Use the rlm-legal-weekly-status skill on the records for this review.
